sql.query: UPDATE tbl_event_milestone_options o SET o.isDefault=0 WHERE o.tenantId=:tenantId AND o.milestoneId=:milestoneId AND o.id<>NULLIF(:id,0) AND :isDefault=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:authorisedUser AND utr.tenantId=o.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)

INSERT INTO tbl_event_milestone_options (id,tenantId,milestoneId,optionName,displayOrder,colour,isDefault,isComplete,isActive,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT NULLIF(:id,0),:tenantId,m.id,TRIM(:optionName),:displayOrder,:colour,:isDefault,:isComplete,CASE WHEN :isDefault2=1 THEN 1 ELSE :isActive END,:userId,:userId2 FROM tbl_event_milestones m WHERE m.id=:milestoneId AND m.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND NULLIF(TRIM(:optionName2),'') IS NOT NULL AND :colour2 REGEXP '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:authorisedUser AND utr.tenantId=m.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE optionName=VALUES(optionName),displayOrder=VALUES(displayOrder),colour=VALUES(colour),isDefault=VALUES(isDefault),isComplete=VALUES(isComplete),isActive=VALUES(isActive),modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
